title: 第13章 冠军侯：挖开陵墓！看看这淮南王藏着什么玄机
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
刘彻的语气，斩钉截铁，“朕的这位皇叔，本事大得很。他这么做，必然是在图谋一件，惊天动地的大事。”

    他看着霍去病，一字一句地说道：“朕现在，要你，立刻，马上，率领三百绣衣使者，赶赴淮南！”

    绣衣使者！

    霍去病瞳孔一缩。

    这可是皇帝手中，最神秘，也最令人恐惧的一支力量。

    他们由皇帝直接指挥，专司巡查、缉捕、审问，权力之大，甚至可以监察百官，先斩后奏。

    动用这支力量，可见皇帝对此事的重视程度。

    “到了淮南之后，你给朕，彻查！”

    刘彻的声音，变得冰冷刺骨。

    “查什么？”

    霍去病问道。

    “查所有的一切！”

    刘彻眼中闪过厉色，“给朕封锁整个淮南王府，收缴他所有的书籍、丹方、手札！给朕挖开他的王陵，打开他的棺材！朕要亲眼看看，他到底是人是鬼！”

    挖开王陵，打开棺材！

    霍去病心中大震。

    这在注重礼法的汉朝，可是大逆不道，足以让天下士人戳脊梁骨的事情。

    但他没有丝毫犹豫。

    皇帝的命令，就是天。

    “臣，遵旨！”

    “记住。”

    刘彻走到他身边，压低了声音，用只有他们两人才能听到的音量说道，“如果，他真的在棺材里，那便罢了。”

    “如果，他不在……”

    刘彻的眼中，闪过毫不掩饰的杀机。

    “那便给朕，将整个淮南王府，上上下下，给朕查个底朝天！凡是他的心腹，他的门客，他的死士，一个，都不要放过！”

    “若有反抗，格杀勿论！”

    “朕要知道，他到底想做什么！朕要知道，他那所谓的‘长生之法’，到底是什么！”

    霍去病的心，猛地一跳。

    长生之法？

    原来，陛下的真正目的，在这里！

    他终于明白，为何皇帝会如此失态。

    与长生不死相比，什么礼法，什么名声，都变得不值一提。

    “臣，明白了。”

    霍去病重重地点了点头。

    他的眼神，也变得火热起来。

    如果，这个世界上，真的有长生之法……

    那他，作为皇帝最锋利的刀，是不是，也有机会，分一杯羹？

    “去吧。”

    刘彻拍了拍他的肩膀，“朕给你便宜行事之权。在淮南，你的话，就是朕的话！”

    “臣，定不负陛下所托！”

    霍去病转身，大步离去。

    他高大的背影，在夕阳的余晖下，拉出长长的影子，充满了昂扬的斗志和无尽的自信。

    在他看来，这不过是一件，手到擒来的差事。

    一个装神弄鬼的王爷，即便有些手段，又如何能与皇帝的天威抗衡？

    他根本无法想象，自己此去，将要面对的，是一个，何等恐怖的存在。

    他也无法想象，自己的命运，以及那三百绣衣使者，数万淮南百姓的命运，都将因为他此行的这个决定，而走向一个万劫不复的深渊。

    刘彻看着霍去病离去的背影，缓缓吐出一口气。

    他重新走回地图前，目光，落在了寿春的位置。

    “皇叔啊皇叔，你最好，是真的死了。”

    “否则，朕会让你知道，这普天之下，莫非王土。就算你真的成了仙，也得在朕的脚下，盘着！”
content_en:
Liu Che's tone was decisive, "My imperial uncle is very capable. By doing this, he must be planning something earth-shattering."

    He looked at Huo Qubing and said word by word: "I want you to lead three hundred embroidered messengers to Huainan immediately, right away!"

    The messenger of embroidered clothes!

    Huo Qubing's pupils shrank.

    This is the most mysterious and frightening force in the hands of the emperor.

    They are under the direct command of the emperor and are responsible for patrolling, arresting, and interrogating. They are so powerful that they can even supervise hundreds of officials and kill them first before reporting them.

    Using this force shows how seriously the emperor takes this matter.

    "After we arrive in Huainan, please give me a thorough investigation!"

    Liu Che's voice became bone-chilling.

    "What to check?"

    Huo Qubing asked.

    "Check everything!"

    A stern look flashed in Liu Che's eyes, "Seal the entire Huainan Palace for me and confiscate all his books, prescriptions, and manuscripts! Dig up his royal tomb and open his coffin! I want to see with my own eyes whether he is a human or a ghost!"

    Dig up the royal tomb and open the coffin!

    Huo Qubing was shocked.

    In the Han Dynasty, which valued etiquette and law, this was a treasonous act that was enough to make scholars all over the world poke their spines.

    But he didn't hesitate.

    The emperor's order is heaven.

    "My lord, I obey the order!"

    "Remember."

    Liu Che walked up to him, lowered his voice, and said at a volume that only the two of them could hear, "If he is really in the coffin, then that's it."

    "If he's not here..."

    Liu Che's eyes flashed with undisguised murderous intent.

    "Then give me the entire Huainan Prince's Mansion, top to bottom, and check it out! Don't let go of any of his confidants, his disciples, or his dead soldiers!"

    "If there is resistance, shoot without mercy!"

    "I want to know what he wants to do! I want to know what his so-called 'method of immortality' is!"

    Huo Qubing's heart skipped a beat.

    The way to live forever?

    It turns out that His Majesty’s true purpose is here!

    He finally understood why the emperor was so gloomy.

    Compared with immortality, all etiquette and reputation are nothing.

    "My lord, I understand."

    Huo Qubing nodded seriously.

    His eyes also became fiery.

    If, in this world, there really is a way to live forever...

    So, as the emperor's sharpest knife, does he also have a chance to get a share of the pie?

    "Go ahead."

    Liu Che patted his shoulder and said, "I give you the right to do whatever you want. In Huainan, your words are my words!"

    "My lord, I will definitely live up to your majesty's trust!"

    Huo Qubing turned around and strode away.

    His tall back cast a long shadow under the afterglow of the setting sun, full of high morale and endless self-confidence.

    In his opinion, this is just an easy job.

    How can a pretending prince, even if he has some means, compete with the emperor's power?

    He simply could not imagine what a terrifying existence he would face when he went there.

    He could not imagine that his own fate, as well as the fate of the three hundred embroidered messengers and tens of thousands of Huainan people, would all lead to an abyss of eternal destruction because of his decision to go there.

    Liu Che looked at Huo Qubing's leaving figure and slowly let out a breath.

    He walked back to the map and his eyes fell on Shouchun's position.

    "Uncle Emperor, Uncle Emperor, it's best for you to be really dead."

    "Otherwise, I will let you know that there is no king in this world. Even if you really become an immortal, you still have to be under my feet!"
title_en: Chapter 13 Champion: Dig the tomb! Let’s see what secrets this King of Huainan hides
